description: Read every source tag this website sees: Owned and Competitor (entity), the built-in classes AthenaHQ classifies automatically (platform: Media, Social, Government, E-Commerce, Review sites, PR Wire, Academic and research, Wiki) and the website's custom tags. Built-in tags list only what this website added or removed, never the platform's own patterns; custom tags list their patterns. Read this before proposing, creating, editing or deleting tags, and prefer adding hosts to a built-in tag over creating a near-duplicate. To find sources no tag covers, call source_tags__get_sources with untagged true. Filter by name substring or tag ID; page tags with offset, page one tag's patterns with tag ID and pattern offset.

limit.description: Tags per page: 1 through 50, default 20. Use offset for the next page.

query.description: Optional tag-name substring. Omit to list all names.

tag_id.description: Actual UUID returned by this tool. Omit to list all tags; never use a placeholder.

name: source_tags__list
